blocks.text: The spend baseline is coming together on our side, and the one thing that would keep it moving is a fuller cut of your purchasing data. Brenda Rodriguez has the category structure roughed out from the files your team sent over, and Daniel Leach is reconciling those figures against the {{fact:f:E-2014-001.client}} vendor master now, which is where the first real gaps in coverage are showing up.

Two things from your side would help the cost work along: read access to the purchase-order detail for the last two full years, so that we can see spend by category rather than by cost center, and half an hour with whoever owns the day-to-day supplier relationships, so that Daniel Leach is confirming from a short conversation what he would otherwise have to infer from the file. I know the timing is tight on your end, David Carter, and I have kept the list as short as the work allows.

If the data needs a sign-off on your side, point me at the right person and I will make the request directly rather than put it back on your desk; otherwise send whatever is easiest straight to me, Matthew Parrish, and I will get it to the team the same day and keep this thread as the running record.
